newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 23 - 25 bln francs of OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 23 - 25 bln francs of OATs Thursday.

text.p: France will offer between 23 and 25 billion francs ($4.5 billion) of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on February 6, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the current 10-year benchmark OAT, the 5.50 percent April 25, 2007 OAT, with a payment date of February 25, the statement said.
The Treasury also said it would offer the 6.50 percent April 25, 2011 OAT, with a payment date of February 25.
